title: Night Before the Secret Realm
next_chapter_hook: From beneath the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's black纱斗篷, a pair of ink-black eyes met Chen Ji's gaze. The familiarity and venom in that gaze made Chen Ji's heart skip a beat—that was not the look a stranger should have.

text.content: The voice of the Dragon Vein Guardian rang like an ancient bell, echoing through the depths of his bloodline. The low, majestic tone spoke: "Chen family descendant, I have waited ten thousand years for you." Chen Ji felt a burning sensation in his chest, as if something dormant for millennia was awakening. An ancient jade token materialized from the void and dove into his brow center, and a strange sensation of cold and heat interweaving spread instantly through his limbs and meridians.

At that moment, three sonorous bells rang abruptly in the distance, like thunderclaps tearing through the sky, pulling him back from the mysterious consciousness space to reality. Chen Ji opened his eyes and found himself still standing on the plaza outside the secret realm entrance, but the surrounding atmosphere had changed drastically—the flags of various sects fluttered wildly in the wind, disciples' whispers formed a buzzing tide, and beside him, several unfamiliar auras had appeared out of nowhere.

dialogue.content: The secret realm... is about to open?

text.content: He muttered softly to himself, but his gaze swept the surroundings without moving. The positions of the three great sects were now clearly visible—the Xuanwu Sect's crimson-gold battle banners were the most eye-catching, with Han Lie at the head leading a neatly arrayed group of disciples, bristling with killing intent; at the Tianqing Sect's position, Su Qingyao watched him with icy eyes, the scrutiny and confusion in her gaze even more pronounced than usual; and among the Qingyun Sect's ranks, a white-haired elder sat serenely on a spirit palanquin, his aura restrained yet giving an unfathomable impression.

dialogue.content: Tch, is this all the Tianqing Sect sent? Han Lie's voice rang across the entire field like a great bell. He strode forward, his spiritual pressure pressing down on Chen Ji like a mountain. "Even sending a useless waste of a disciple into the secret realm—are you planning to send him to his death?"

text.content: A burst of laughter erupted around him. Xuanwu Sect disciples chimed in one after another, and disciples from other sects who had long seethed under Han Lie's oppression but dared not speak out now wore expressions of schadenfreude. Chen Ji lowered his eyes to his own toes, his shoulders trembling slightly—to outsiders, it looked exactly like he had been terrified out of his wits. Only he himself knew he was suppressing the upward curve of his lips with every fiber of his being.

dialogue.content: What Han Shixiong says is correct... Chen Ji lowered his head, his voice barely a whisper. "This younger brother is indeed weak in strength, but the sect has ordered it, and I dare not disobey..." He surreptitiously glanced toward Su Qingyao's direction. "I hope Senior Sister Su will give me much protection..."

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even more tightly. She always felt there was something more beneath Chen Ji's words—the word "protection" carried a depth of meaning, but she couldn't grasp its flaw for the moment. This useless junior brother, his cultivation was so pathetic—why did she always feel seen through whenever their eyes met?

dialogue.content: Enough, enough! Han Lie waved impatiently. "A waste should have a waste's觉悟, don't go die inside and disgrace the face of righteous cultivators!" He turned to leave, but suddenly the eastern sky darkened, and a mass of black clouds pressed down at alarming speed.

text.content: Demonic Path! It's the Demonic Path army! Someone cried out in alarm, and the formerly noisy plaza fell silent in an instant. Disciples from all sects reached for their weapons, tension spiking to its limit. Within those black clouds, countless figures in black robes were vaguely visible, and at the front of the formation, a banner embroidered with a blood-red lotus fluttered in the wind—the emblem of the Demonic Path Holy Sect.

The black clouds settled, and the Demonic Path commander-in-chief finally revealed his true form. A black纱斗篷 shrouded his figure completely, leaving only a pair of ink-black eyes visible. That gaze swept across the entire assembly, carrying an inexplicable scrutiny. When it fell upon Chen Ji, it paused for an instant—that instant was almost imperceptible, yet it made a cold sweat break out across Chen Ji's back.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing concealed herself in the crowd, her gaze shuttling between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander. As the Holy Sect Saintess of the Demonic Path, she naturally knew who led this army—but that person's identity shouldn't have appeared in a setting like this. She quietly crushed a transmission jade符 in her sleeve, the prearranged signal between her and Chen Ji: something changed.

text.content: Chen Ji felt the vibration from that jade符 and his heart tightened. He subtly sent back a known signal, telling Ye Qing to stay calm. Meanwhile, his consciousness slipped into his Mental Sea, where the yellowed fragment was faintly warming—the foresight power of the Tianji Record was stirring, as if warning him of something.

choice.prompt: The brief moment the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's gaze lingered on Chen Ji set alarm bells ringing in his heart. He knew his long-laid plan had reached its most critical juncture, and now he needed to decide his next move.

choices.text: Continue to endure and lay low
choices.description: Maintain the useless waste persona, don't stir the hornet's nest, wait for the hidden pieces to activate on their own
choices.visible_cost: Requires energy expenditure to maintain the acting
choices.visible_reward: The situation will develop entirely according to plan
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander-in-chief's identity remains a mystery; variables are hard to predict

text.content: Chen Ji subtly lowered his head, pressing his aura to its lowest, assuming the posture of someone terrified by the Demonic Path's might. Yet his peripheral vision remained locked on the figure beneath the black纱斗篷, his mind racing to calculate where those long-buried hidden pieces must have reached by now.

choices.description: While all attention is drawn by the Demonic Path, trigger the key hidden piece ahead of schedule
choices.visible_reward: Instantly reverse the situation and gain strategic advantage
choices.risk_hint: Exposing intentions too early may trigger chain reactions

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers quietly formed a seal within his sleeve, and a spiritual light invisible to others slipped silently into the ground. At the same moment, several seemingly ordinary corners of the plaza flickered with faint light simultaneously—the formation nodes laid long ago were being activated. The situation began tilting in his favor.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight to investigate the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's true identity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence and seize initiative
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is irreversible and may trigger unknown backlash

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness sank into his Mental Sea, and the yellowed fragment unfolded slowly. Foresight surged, and blurred images began forming before his eyes—but just as he tried to see the face beneath the black纱斗篷, the image suddenly distorted, and a pair of jet-black eyes seemed to pierce through time and space to meet his gaze! That was...

Just as all forces stood in extreme tension, a golden fissure suddenly tore open in the sky. A boundless and supreme might poured down from that rift, pressing down so that everyone present couldn't help but lower their heads. An aged yet majestic voice descended from the Nine Heavens: "The secret realm... is about to open. All forces, hold your positions."

That was the Voice of the Heavenly Eye! Chen Ji's heart shook as he looked up at that golden fissure. He saw a sight that made his spine crawl—that enormous golden vertical pupil hung above the Nine Heavens, like a deity gazing down at ants, coldly observing all living beings below. And when that gaze swept over him, it seemed to pause for an instant—the sensation of being watched reminded him of a certain obscure passage on the Tianji Record fragment.

dialogue.content: (Every generation of prophets... are all pieces in a chess game... the Tianji Record is merely one of them...) Chen Ji silently recited that passage, a bone-deep chill rising in his heart. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had once said: "You are not yet qualified to know the truth of the Tianji Record."

choice.prompt: The might of the Heavenly Eye enveloped the entire field; the secret realm's opening was imminent. At this critical juncture, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—one of his hidden pieces had reached a point where it could no longer be delayed.

choices.description: Let the hidden pieces continue to ferment, buy more time for layout
choices.visible_cost: Must bear the unknown variables brought by the Demonic Path commander-in-chief
choices.visible_reward: Hidden piece effect maximized, can gain greater advantage in the secret realm

text.content: Chen Ji quietly withdrew his gaze and reassumed that cowardly, humble demeanor. But his divine sense continued scanning the surroundings, sensing those long-planted pieces quietly moving according to his will. Just a bit longer... just a bit longer, and everything would fall into place.

choices.description: Use the chaos to meet with the Demonic Path Saintess, probe the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's true identity
choices.visible_cost: May expose the relationship with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence and eliminate the biggest variable
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is secretly monitoring; one misstep will lead to exposure

dialogue.content: Chen Ji quietly shifted his feet, blending into the crowd. His fingers lightly tapped within his sleeve, and a pre-prepared transmission jade符 was silently activated. A moment later, Ye Qing's voice sounded in his mind: "That commander's identity... I don't know either. But there have been major movements inside the Holy Sect lately—many people were transferred here temporarily."

text.content: Just then, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief suddenly raised his hand, signaling the Demonic Path army to halt. That figure beneath the black纱斗篷 stepped forward alone, standing fixed between the various forces. When those ink-black eyes swept across the assembly, Chen Ji distinctly sensed a familiar aura—that aura... was identical to a certain primordial power recorded on the Tianji Record fragment!

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's figure silently appeared at Chen Ji's side, her face somewhat pale: "Chen Ji, that person... is wrong. I can sense it—he carries the aura of the Tianji Record, exactly the same as what I sensed from you before." Her voice carried a tremor. "Could he... also be a prophet?"

text.content: Prophet? Chen Ji's heart tightened. The Tianji Record did mention that through the ages, holders of the Tianji Record were not limited to one person—before them, countless others had been chosen by Heaven to become pieces in the game. And those who failed... their fates were not recorded anywhere in the Tianji Record.

Just then, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief seemed to sense something and slowly turned around. Those ink-black eyes pierced through the crowd, landing directly on Chen Ji. In that moment their eyes met, Chen Ji's heart contracted violently—the emotions contained in that gaze were far too complex: venom, familiarity, and even a hint of... nostalgia?

That was not the look a stranger should have. Alarm bells rang in Chen Ji's heart. He could be certain he had never met this person, yet that sense of familiarity was seared into his soul like a brand. He instinctively wanted to activate the Tianji Record for foresight, but the fragment trembled violently at that moment, as if issuing some kind of warning.

The Demonic Path commander-in-chief's lips slightly curved upward, revealing a profound smile. He opened his mouth, and his voice came like from the depths of the Nine Abyssal Pits, ice-cold yet familiar: "Tianqing Sect's little friend... it seems we haven't met for a very long time." The voice directly penetrated space, falling clearly into Chen Ji's ears, yet no one else perceived it.

dialogue.content: (Who... exactly is this person?) Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He struggled to maintain the calm on his face, but his heart was already churning like a tempest. Mo Xiansheng had said he wasn't qualified to know the truth of the Tianji Record—and now, was this Demonic Path commander-in-chief with the same aura as the Tianji Record part of that truth?

text.content: Just as the atmosphere froze to its limit, the golden fissure in the sky suddenly widened. A brilliant pillar of light poured down from the rift, landing squarely in the center of the plaza—the secret realm entrance was slowly opening. All forces quickly gathered their auras and turned their gazes toward where the light pillar stood. The Demonic Path commander-in-chief also withdrew his gaze, disappearing once more beneath the black纱斗篷.

But in the instant of turning, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief spoke again, his voice audible only to Chen Ji: "Chen family descendant... heir of the Tianji Record... you think yourself the chess player, but you don't realize we are all merely pieces on Heaven's chessboard. And I... was once just like you." With those words, the black纱斗篷 abruptly billowed upward, and the figure vanished into the Demonic Path army.

Chen Ji stood rooted in place, gazing at the figure disappearing into the black clouds, speechless for a long while. The jade token at his chest faintly warmed, seemingly responding to those profound words. He suddenly recalled what the Dragon Vein Guardian had said: "I have waited ten thousand years for you." Ten thousand years... if that person was also a former prophet, how long had he waited? And what did his appearance mean?

Ye Qing's voice sounded in his mind again, tinged with urgency: "Chen Ji, are you alright? That person's aura just now... reminded me of certain legends within the Holy Sect. They say when the Demonic Path Holy Sect was first established, there was an unmatched powerhouse who attempted to defy fate and change destiny, but ultimately was counterattacked by Heaven, turning into a remnant soul sealed in the deepest Forbidden Grounds of the Holy Sect..."

dialogue.content: Remnant soul... sealed... Chen Ji murmured to himself, suddenly remembering Mo Xiansheng's form of existence. His pupils contracted sharply. "You mean... the Demonic Path commander-in-chief could be a remnant soul that was released?" Ye Qing gave no answer, but her silence spoke volumes.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Whatever that person's identity, the secret realm was about to open—he had no time to dwell on this. He quietly gripped the jade token in his sleeve, sensing the power the Dragon Vein Guardian had left him. Although variables had appeared in the situation, his long-laid plans would not change—in the secret realm, he must find what he needed.

Just then, Su Qingyao suddenly appeared beside him, gazing at him with complex eyes: "Chen Ji, it seemed the Demonic Path commander-in-chief said something to you just now." Her tone was calm, but her eyes gleamed with scrutiny. "What... exactly are you hiding?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, wearing a bitter smile on his face: "Senior Sister Su is joking; this junior brother is useless, what could I possibly have worth hiding?" His tone was sincere and helpless. "Perhaps the Demonic Path commander-in-chief simply... made a mistake about who I was."

Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then suddenly stepped forward, lowering her voice: "Chen Ji, I don't know what you're scheming, but I warn you—within the secret realm, dangers lurk on all sides. If you really are... that person, don't let yourself die in there." Her gaze flickered, as if hesitating over something, before finally turning and walking away.

text.content: Chen Ji watched Su Qingyao's departing back, the corners of his mouth slightly lifting. That woman, in the end, still showed a spark of compassion. He withdrew his gaze and looked toward the secret realm entrance slowly opening. Within the light pillar, a vast world outline was faintly visible—that was the ancient ruins, a convergence of countless fortunes and perils.

At the secret realm entrance, the three great sects and the Demonic Path army stood in stark opposition, each force making final preparations. Han Lie was in quiet conversation with Xuanwu Sect disciples, his gaze occasionally sweeping toward Chen Ji, filled with contempt and disdain. And that figure beneath the black纱斗篷 stood motionlessly at the very front of the Demonic Path army, as if waiting for something.

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, taking everything in. His hidden pieces were already in place, merely awaiting the moment of maturity; and the variables brought by the Demonic Path commander-in-chief would have to wait until inside the secret realm to be dealt with. He took a deep breath, feeling the jade token at his chest faintly warming—that was the final gift the Dragon Vein Guardian had left him.

Just then, the aged yet majestic voice of the golden vertical pupil in the sky rang out once more: "The secret realm entrance has opened. All of you... enter." With those words, the brilliant light pillar suddenly expanded, forming a massive gateway. All forces surged into action, disciples streaming in one after another. And Chen Ji, blending into the Tianqing Sect ranks, walked toward that gate of light.

Just as he was about to step through the light gate, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's black纱斗篷 suddenly stirred without wind. A pale hand emerged from beneath the斗篷, pointing directly toward Chen Ji's direction. That gesture lasted only an instant, yet Chen Ji distinctly felt a tremor from the depths of his soul—that was a resonance of origin, the unique connection shared between Tianji Record holders.

Chen Ji whirled sharply, just in time to meet those ink-black eyes. The interweaving familiarity and venom in that gaze made him momentarily unable to look away. Only when Su Qingyao's voice rang in his ear did he snap awake: "Chen Ji, let's go!" He took a deep breath and stepped into the light gate. And in that instant of his disappearance, he clearly saw the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's lips curve into an eerie arc.
